variant_hint.yorker: Seedha panjon par. Perfect ho to ghatak, loose ho to full toss.
variant_hint.good_length: Bharosemand stock ball. Green pitch par seam hoti hai.
variant_hint.bouncer: Short aur uthti hui. Hard pitch par batter ko hadbada deti hai.
variant_hint.slower: Chhupi hui dheemi pace, jo jaldi chale bat ko chakma deti hai. Slow pitch par grip karti hai.
variant_hint.inswing: Hawa mein pads ki taraf mudti hai. LBW aur bowled ki talaash.
variant_hint.outswing: Bat se door nikalti hai. Slips mein edge ki talaash.
variant_hint.offspin: Batter ki taraf ghoomti hai. Slow pitch par khoob grip karti hai.
variant_hint.legspin: Bahar ki taraf ghoomti hai: edges aur stumpings. Loose ho to pitti hai.
intent_hint.attack: Wickets dhoondhta hai, par chauke bhi zyada jaate hain.
intent_hint.contain: Runs sookh jaate hain. Wickets bhi kam milte hain.
intent_hint.setup: Taiyaari wali ball, jo aapki agli attacking ball ko aur ghatak banati hai.
field_hint.attacking: Slips aur close catchers. Third man aur fine leg khaali.
field_hint.balanced: Single rokne wala ring. Mid-off aur midwicket khaali.
field_hint.sweeper: Boundary ke fielders chauke rokte hain. Mid-on khaali.
shot_hint.defend: Ball roko. Sabse safe shot, run kabhi-kabhaar.
shot_hint.rotate: Gap mein push karo aur ek-do run lo. Kam risk.
shot_hint.drive: Front foot par, full balls, zameen ke saath-saath.
shot_hint.cut_pull: Back foot par, short ya bahar ki balls, square par.
shot_hint.sweep: Ek ghutne par baithkar, spin aur full balls par.
shot_hint.loft: Hawa mein chauka ya chhakka. Sahi length chahiye.
shot_hint.leave: Jaane do. Off ke bahar safe, stumps par khatarnaak.
pitch_hint.green: Seam aur swing. Edges slips tak pahunchte hain.
pitch_hint.hard: Pace aur bounce. Timed shots tezi se boundary jaate hain.
pitch_hint.slow: Spin aur slower balls grip karti hain. Ball zameen par rakho.
ghost.anchor.name: Anchor
ghost.anchor.style: Saadhe hue overs aur dheeraj wali batting. Shuruaat ke liye sabse friendly ghost.
ghost.swinger.name: Swinger
ghost.swinger.style: Dono taraf swing, catchers taiyaar, aur cover drive par fida.
ghost.enforcer.name: Dabang
ghost.enforcer.style: Sweeper field ke saath bouncers aur yorkers. Har ball par bada shot.
ghost.trickster.name: Jaadugar
ghost.trickster.style: Spin, slower balls aur chaalaak jaal. Sweep karke gaps dhoondhne mein maahir.
ghost.maestro.name: Ustaad
ghost.maestro.style: Har pitch ke liye sahi plan. Aapki field ko kitaab ki tarah padhne mein maahir.
advice.unlock.slower: Unlock: apne over mein batter ko 6 ya kam runs par roko
advice.unlock.inswing: Unlock: batter ko bowled ya LBW karo
advice.unlock.outswing: Unlock: batter ko catch out karwao
advice.unlock.where: Ye Friend Duel aur Group Cup khelkar milti hain. Inhe kabhi khareeda nahi ja sakta.
advice.pitch.green: Green pitch: good length par seam aur swing sabse achhi chalti hai, khaaskar pehli teen balls mein. Spin par run banana aasaan hai.
advice.pitch.hard: Hard pitch: yorker aur bouncer kaam karte hain. Yorker ke alawa koi bhi full ball aasaani se maari jaati hai.
advice.pitch.slow: Slow pitch: spin aur slower balls grip karti hain. Tez short balls aur full swing aasaani se maari jaati hain.
advice.weather.humid: Humid hawa: ball zyada swing karti hai.
advice.weather.dew: Os: ball geeli hai aur pakadna mushkil, isliye batting aasaan hoti hai. Spinners ko sabse zyada nuksaan hota hai.
advice.summary.title: Tumhara over
advice.summary.lines: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# alag lines}}
advice.summary.note: Ye game ke model se ek salah hai, koi vaada nahi.
advice.read.predictable: Predictable: {count} balls bilkul ek jaisi hain. Har repeat par run banana aasaan hota hai.
advice.read.against_pitch: {count} balls is pitch ke khilaaf jaati hain. Pitch tip dekho.
advice.read.weak_ball: Ball {n} par yahan run banana aasaan hai. Utni hi energy wali koi aur ball behtar rahegi.
advice.read.setup_wasted: Bekaar jaal: ball {n} ke turant baad ek alag attacking ball chahiye.
advice.read.setup_ready: Jaal taiyaar: ball {n} ball {next} ke liye jaal bichhati hai.
advice.read.field_attacking: Ye balls attacking field ke saath behtar chalengi.
advice.read.field_balanced: Ye balls balanced field ke saath behtar chalengi.
advice.read.field_sweeper: Ye balls sweeper field ke saath behtar chalengi.
advice.read.attack: Poora attack: zyada wickets, par chauke-chhakke bhi zyada.
advice.read.contain: Safe khel: kam chauke, par wickets bhi kam.
advice.read.energy_left: {n} energy bachi hai. Koi tez ya zyada chaalaak ball ise use kar sakti hai.
explain.yorker_vs_defend: Yorker par bat neeche daba diya: safe, par run mushkil.
explain.yorker_vs_rotate: Yorker ko nikaal kar ek run churaana hi safe aur smart jawab hai.
explain.yorker_vs_drive: Yorker par drive ke liye perfect timing chahiye: ball seedha panjon par hai.
explain.yorker_vs_cut_pull: Panjon par aayi ball par cut ya pull ki koi jagah nahi.
explain.yorker_vs_sweep: Yorker par sweep matlab pads aur stumps ke saath jua.
explain.yorker_vs_loft: Yorker ke neeche bat laane ki jagah hi nahi: loft ya to hawa mein tang jaata hai ya miss hota hai.
explain.good_length_vs_rotate: Naram haathon se gap mein: good length ball se run nikaalne ka safe tareeka.
explain.good_length_vs_drive: Drive ko full ball pasand hai, short nahi: faisla length ne kiya.
explain.good_length_vs_cut_pull: Cut aur pull ke liye ball short chahiye: faisla length ne kiya.
explain.good_length_vs_sweep: Sweep full ball par chalta hai, short par nahi: faisla length ne kiya.
explain.good_length_vs_loft: Loft ke liye full ball chahiye, ya hook ke liye short. Good length ko uthaana sabse mushkil.
explain.bouncer_vs_defend: Bouncer ko rokna awkward hai: ball gloves ki taraf uthti hai.
explain.bouncer_vs_rotate: Uthte bouncer ko gap mein bhejna mushkil.
explain.bouncer_vs_drive: Bouncer par drive matlab us ball ke peeche jaana jo wahan hai hi nahi.
explain.bouncer_vs_cut_pull: Short aur uthti ball: timing ho to pull ka poora mauka.
explain.bouncer_vs_sweep: Sir ki oonchai wali ball par sweep nahi hota.
explain.bouncer_vs_loft: Bouncer par hawai hook: time hua to chhakka, top edge laga to catch.
explain.slower_vs_defend: Slower ball ka intezaar karke roka: dheeraj, koi nuksaan nahi.
explain.slower_vs_rotate: Slower ball par naram haath: ek run ke liye aasaani se gap mein.
explain.slower_vs_drive: Slower ball par drive ko intezaar karna padta hai: dheeraj ka fayda, jaldbaazi ka nuksaan.
explain.slower_vs_cut_pull: Short slower ball pull ke liye ruk kar aati hai; full ho to cut ke liye jagah nahi deti.
explain.slower_vs_sweep: Sweep ke aage slower ball ka dhokha kaam nahi aata.
explain.slower_vs_loft: Slower ball par loft ke liye rukna padta hai: bat jaldi chal jaana aasaan hai.
explain.inswing_vs_defend: Seedha bat pads ki taraf aati in-swing ko dhak deta hai.
explain.inswing_vs_rotate: Pads se in-swing ko leg side mein: swing ke saath khelna.
explain.inswing_vs_drive: Full in-swinger ko seedha drive karo to ball udti hai; miss karo to pads line mein.
explain.inswing_vs_cut_pull: In-swinger par cut matlab swing ke khilaaf khelna: jagah nahi milti.
explain.inswing_vs_sweep: In-swinger par sweep se pad beech mein aata hai: LBW ka khatra.
explain.inswing_vs_loft: In-swinger par loft: swing ke upar se gaya to udaan, miss hua to pads line mein.
explain.outswing_vs_defend: Out-swinger par defence: khatra slips mein jaate edge ka hai.
explain.outswing_vs_rotate: Naram haath out-swinger ko third man ki taraf le jaate hain.
explain.outswing_vs_drive: Out-swinger par drive: cover se chauka bhi, outside edge bhi.
explain.outswing_vs_cut_pull: Jagah plus swing: cut hi natural jawab hai.
explain.outswing_vs_sweep: Door jaati ball par sweep ke liye pahunchna padta hai: control mushkil.
explain.outswing_vs_loft: Door jaati swing par loft: edge kabhi door nahi.
explain.offspin_vs_defend: Aage badhkar mazboot defence off-spin ka turn daba deta hai.
explain.offspin_vs_rotate: Andar ghoomti off-spin ko leg side mein khelna aasaan.
explain.offspin_vs_drive: Off-spin par drive matlab ball ke tappe tak pahunchna.
explain.offspin_vs_cut_pull: Andar ghoomti off-spin par cut mein jagah nahi, jab tak long hop na ho.
explain.offspin_vs_sweep: Sweep off-spin ke turn ko be-asar kar deta hai.
explain.offspin_vs_loft: Off-spinner par kadmon ka istemaal: ball full toss ban jaati hai, ya stumping.
explain.legspin_vs_defend: Defensive bat se door ghoomti leg-spin edge dhoondhti hai.
explain.legspin_vs_rotate: Door ghoomti leg-spin ko gap mein bhejna tricky hai.
explain.legspin_vs_drive: Leg-spin par drive: tappe tak pahuncho, warna turn edge dhoondh leta hai.
explain.legspin_vs_cut_pull: Door ghoomti leg-spin cut ke liye jagah deti hai, khaaskar short ho to.
explain.legspin_vs_sweep: Leg-spin ke turn ke khilaaf sweep risky hai.
explain.legspin_vs_loft: Leg-spin par loft: tappe tak pahunche to ball hawa mein, miss hua to stumped.
explain.timing_perfect: Perfect timing: bat bilkul sahi pal par chala.
explain.timing_good: Achhi timing ne shot ka poora fayda dilaaya.
explain.timing_early: Jaldi: ball aane se pehle hi bat nikal gaya.
explain.timing_late: Late: bat neeche aane se pehle ball pahunch chuki thi.
explain.timing_very_early: Bahut jaldi: ball pahunchne se pehle hi shot khatam.
explain.timing_very_late: Bahut late: pace ne bat ko peeche chhod diya.
explain.no_shot: Bat chala hi nahi: baaki kaam ball ne kiya.
explain.loose_ball: Loose ball ek tohfa hai: usse saza dena aasaan.
explain.pinpoint: Pinpoint release: ball bilkul nishane par, koi jagah nahi chhodi.
explain.pitch_green: Green pitch ka asar: seam aur swing ko madad, spin ko nahi.
explain.pitch_hard: Hard pitch ka asar: bouncers aur yorkers ghatak, baaki sab par runs.
explain.pitch_slow: Slow pitch ka asar: spin aur slower balls grip karti hain, pace ruk kar aati hai.
explain.weather_humid: Humid hawa ne swing bowler ki madad ki.
explain.weather_dew: Os se ball geeli hui aur bowler ki grip kamzor padi.
explain.field_gap: Field mein theek wahin gap tha.
explain.field_ring: Ring field ne us shot ko lagbhag koi jagah nahi di.
explain.field_deep: Deep mein fielder tha: saamne aasaan runs, bade shot par khatra.
explain.field_packed: Field ka woh hissa poora bhara tha.
explain.field_slips: Ball slips ki taraf gayi, aur wahan ki fielding ne faisla kiya.
explain.field_close: Close catchers bat ko ghere hue the.
explain.setup_worked: Pichhli ball ne is ball ka jaal bichhaya tha.
explain.repeat_lined_up: Phir wahi ball: batter ke liye ab jaani-pehchaani.
explain.new_batter: Naye batter ki pehli ball: face karne mein sabse mushkil.
explain.against_the_line: Ball ki line ke khilaaf khelna risky hai.
explain.leave_safe: Safe leave: yeh stumps par kabhi nahi ja rahi thi.
explain.leave_survived: Chhodi aur bach gaye: yeh stumps par lag sakti thi.
explain.unanswered: Time par jawab nahi aaya, isliye ball safe leave maani gayi.
explain.last_ball_scramble: Aakhri ball ki bhaagdaud: har ball par daudne ki keemat hoti hai.
explain.run_out_risk: Fielder ke theek saamne tez run lena risky hai.
explain.stumped_charge: Spinner par aage nikle, shot chooka, aur baaki kaam keeper ne kiya.
explain.dead_ball: Dead ball: do wicket pehle hi gir chuke the, isliye yeh ball nahi gini gayi.

guide.title: Sealed Six kaise jeetein
guide.intro: Har match mein do chhoti innings hoti hain: aap ek over daalte ho aur ek over face karte ho. Samajhdaari se plan banao, swipe ki timing sahi rakho, aur apne dost ko maat do.
guide.sealing.title: Sealed overs: koi jhaankna nahi
guide.sealing.body: Match se pehle aap apni chhe balls ka plan banakar lock karte ho. Lock karte hi plan ek secret code se seal ho jaata hai, jise na koi badal sakta hai, na dekh sakta hai, aap bhi nahi. Aapka dost bhi yahi karta hai. Jab dono batting kar lete ho, tab overs khulte hain aur poora match saamne aata hai. Koi bhi check kar sakta hai ki codes match karte hain, isliye cheating namumkin hai.
guide.match.title: Match kaise chalta hai
guide.match.body: Har player chhe balls ka ek over daalta hai aur doosre ke over par batting karta hai. Do wicket girte hi innings khatam, phir bhi aap har ball khelte ho taaki kisi ko pata na chale. Reveal se pehle aapko apne runs ya wickets nahi dikhte, sirf yeh ki har shot ki timing kaisi rahi. Zyada runs banane wala jeetta hai.
guide.energy.title: Energy: sirf rockets nahi phenk sakte
guide.energy.body: Aapki chhe balls ke liye 15 energy hai. Spin aur good length sasti hain; swing, bouncer aur slower ball thodi mehngi; aur yorker sabse mehngi. Pace ka har agla level ek energy aur leta hai. Chhe yorkers kabhi fit nahi hongi, isliye mix karke daalo. Super Ball ka apna chhota quota hai.
guide.intent.title: Intent: har ball ka secret plan
guide.intent.body: Attack wickets dhoondhta hai, par chauke bhi zyada deta hai. Run roko se runs kam bante hain, par wickets bhi kam milte hain. Jaal bichhao ek shaant ball hai jo aapki agli attacking ball ko zyada ghatak banati hai, bas dono mein farq hona chahiye: short phir full, tez phir dheemi, andar phir bahar. Batter aapka intent kabhi nahi dekhta.
guide.timing.title: Timing: swipe karo aur chhodo
guide.timing.body: Shot chuno, phir jahan maarna hai us taraf swipe karo. Jis pal aap ungli uthaate ho, wahi aapki timing hai: ball pahunchte hi ungli uthao, to perfect timing. Tez balls kam time deti hain aur dheeme spinners intezaar karwaate hain. Pace ka badlaav ek jaal hai: tez ball ke baad dheemi ball par jaldi ho jaana aasaan hai.
guide.pitches.title: Pitch ko padho
guide.pitch.green: Green pitch: ghaas se ball swing aur seam hoti hai, aur edges slips tak pahunchte hain. Seam aur swing bowlers ko khaaskar pehli teen balls par maza aata hai. Spinners ko nahi.
guide.pitch.hard: Hard pitch: tez aur bouncy. Bouncers aur yorkers khatarnaak hain, par achhi timing wale shots seedhe boundary jaate hain. Cut aur pull yahan khoob chalte hain.
guide.pitch.slow: Slow pitch: ball grip karti hai aur ruk kar aati hai. Spinners aur slower balls ka raaj; pace aur bounce be-asar. Hawai shots mushkil hain, isliye ball zameen par rakho aur spinners ko sweep karo.
guide.weather.body: Mausam ka asar chhota hai aur hamesha dikhta hai: humid raat swing ki madad karti hai, aur os se ball geeli hoti hai, isliye spinners ki grip kam ho jaati hai.
guide.super_ball.title: Super Ball
guide.super_ball.body: Over ka plan banate waqt aap ek extra ball bhi chunte ho: Super Ball. Yeh sirf tab kaam aati hai jab score barabar ho. Har player doosre ki Super Ball khelta hai, aur jo us par zyada runs banaye, wahi jeetta hai.
guide.super_ball.ladder: Phir bhi barabar? Kam wickets ganwaane wala jeetta hai. Phir bhi barabar? Zyada chauke-chhakke wala jeetta hai. Phir bhi barabar? To match tie, aur aisa bahut kam hota hai.
